events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, Somerset.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. Which track is your favourite deep cut?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His unparalleled stage presence and incredible voice continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Digging into The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul', released 61 years ago today. A pivotal album that saw the Fab Four evolve their sound.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On this day, we reflect on the immense loss of John Lennon, 46 years ago. His impact on music and culture remains immeasurable.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the iconic English singer-songwriter and actor, was born on January 8, 1947, in Brixton, London.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true chameleon of rock and an artistic pioneer.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Aaron Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today. His music lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Roderick David Stewart, the British singer and songwriter, was born on January 10, 1945, in Highgate, London.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness! What's your favourite 'Nutty Boy' anthem?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English musician, singer, and songwriter Paul Antony Young was born on January 17, 1956, in Luton, Bedfordshire.

angles.name: Paul Young's Birthday
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home! Happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Dolly Rebecca Parton, the legendary American country music singer-songwriter, was born on January 19, 1946, in Sevier County, Tennessee.

angles.name: Queen of Country's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! An icon of music, philanthropy, and pure joy. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow, lead vocalist of Take That, was born on January 20, 1971, in Frodsham, Cheshire.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A songwriting powerhouse and a true pop legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean was born Leslie Sebastian Charles on January 21, 1950, in Fyzabad, Trinidad and Tobago.

angles.name: Billy Ocean's Birthday
angles.copy: When the going gets tough, the tough get going! Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean.

events.title: 38 years since the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, James Brown, and Little Richard.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Inaugural
angles.copy: 38 years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of that inaugural class?
